title: Card 3: Counter har App ko alag range deta. App range se agla number, phir base62

callouts.red: App 1 range me 400 pe crash ho gaya
callouts.green: 401 se 1000 bekaar, jaan-boojh ke. 3.5 lakh crore me farak nahi

callouts.red: Maine aur Ravi ne ek hi custom code maanga
callouts.green: DB ka UNIQUE ek ko rokta, use 409
callouts.green2: Lambai dekho, admin jaise reserved naam nahi

callouts.red: UUID ya lambe link ka hash (pehle 7 akshar) lete?
callouts.green: UUID 36 akshar, lamba. Hash me do link ka code same ho sakta
callouts.green2: Har baar DB me 'pehle se hai?' dekhna padta. Counter me takkar hi nahi

callouts.green: App ki range chalti rehti, tab tak Counter ki copy uth jaati

callouts.red: Har number Redis INCR se le lete?
callouts.green: Chalta, par har link pe ek call. Range me 1000 link pe ek
callouts.green2: Ek bhi number bekaar na jaaye, to range ka fayda hi khatam

callouts.red: Range khatam? Counter se agli range le lo.
callouts.green: Agla code andaza na lage: number shuffle / XOR, phir base62

callouts.red: base62 = 0-9, a-z, A-Z: 125 = '21', 100 crore = '15FTGg'. Do log same lamba link dein to dono ko alag code.
callouts.green: Ek hi code chahiye to pehle lambe link ke hash pe dekh lo

kyun: Counter kabhi dohraata nahi, to code bhi nahi dohraata, check ki zaroorat hi nahi. Range ke andar App khud number deta, har link pe Counter tak nahi jaata. 1000 link pe ek call
